verdict.rationale: Graphite installs as a GitHub App on your organization, and its AI reviews can be turned on in a few clicks with no configuration. Once enabled, Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in the selected repos and leaves comments with suggested fixes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the reviews appear as native inline GitHub PR comments, GitLab support (a community user says it isn't offered), and independent hands-on confirmation of review turnaround time.
